# Contributing

This is the document with contributing guidelines.

GitHub surfaces this document in other places to make it easier to discover:

- a tab on the main page in the repository overview (below the list of files, next to the `README`)
- a link on the main page in the repository sidebar (in the top-right corner, in the `About` section)
- a link in the reminder message when opening issues and when opening pull requests (below the PR
  description)
- a link in the list of helpful resources when opening pull requests (in the bottom-right corner)

Reference: <https://docs.github.com/en/communities/setting-up-your-project-for-healthy-contributions/setting-guidelines-for-repository-contributors>
